PCI DSS v4.0.1 (as a service provider)

Decision 2026-09-26: keep the payment processor national rather than state-specific. As a payment processor it stores, processes, and transmits cardholder data for merchants, so PCI DSS applies to it as a service provider through card-brand and acquirer contracts. It is also a bank service provider to its sponsor and client banks, so the federal notice duty in 12 CFR 53.4 applies (verify text). NYDFS Part 500 is kept only as an applicability check if the company holds a New York license.
